name: Source of authority (SOA)
short_description: In hybrid identity, the source of authority is the directory that has final say over an object's identity attributes. Microsoft Entra ID can take over the source of authority for synced groups and users from on-premises Active Directory.

evidence.quote: In directory terms, the source of authority determines which system has final say over an object's identity attributes.
Source of authority or SOOA doesn't mean where a group happened to be born.
Source of authority isn't a global toggle, it's per object each group.
